title.value: Counterexamples on the monotonicity of delay optimal strategies for energy harvesting transmitters
title.justification: The title is clearly mentioned at the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: Counterexamples on the monotonicity of delay optimal strategies for energy harvesting transmitters

analysis.description: The paper studies the delay optimal transmission strategies for energy harvesting transmitters using stochastic data and energy arrival processes and Markov decision theory. It presents counterexamples showing that the delay optimal policy may not be monotonic as expected, and explores the performance impact of this phenomenon on energy-harvesting systems.

type.justification: The paper is focused on providing theoretical counterexamples and proofs related to the monotonicity of delay optimal strategies in energy-harvesting systems.
type.quote: We show that the delay optimal policy for energy harvesting communication systems is not necessarily monotone in battery or queue state.
